#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
const ll MOD = 998244353;

ll invl(ll a, ll mod) {
    ll b = mod, p = 1, q = 0;
    while (b > 0) {
        ll c = a / b;
        ll d = a;
        a = b;
        b = d % b;
        d = p;
        p = q;
        q = d - c * q;
    }
    return p < 0 ? p + mod : p;
}

vector<ll> guessFrac(ll n, ll mod) {
    ll minval = mod;
    ll argnum = -1, argden = 0;
    for (int den = 1; den <= 200000; den++) {
        ll num = n * den % mod;
        if (num * 2 >= mod) num -= mod;
        if (abs(num) + den < minval) {
            minval = abs(num) + den;
            argnum = num;
            argden = den;
        }
    }
    if (argden == 0) return {};
    return {argnum, argden};
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(0);
    ll n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    ll inv_m1 = invl(m + 1, MOD);
    ll ans = (1 + inv_m1 * n) % MOD;
    ll base = inv_m1 * ((m * (m + n + 1) % MOD)) % MOD;
    ll u = 0;
    for (ll i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        u = (u + invl(i, MOD)) % MOD;
    }
    ans = (base * u + ans) % MOD;
    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
